en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Al Husayn Bin Ahmad Al Minqary, from his maternal uncle who said,
‘I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘The one who eats a meal he had not been invited to, so rather is eating a piece from the Fire’.
en.sarwar: 2. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn abu ‘Umayr from al-Husayn ibn Ahmad al-Minqariy from his maternal uncle who has said the following:
“I once heard abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, saying, ‘If one eats a food to which he is not invited he eats a piece of fire.”’
